cases.input: An official regulator publishes a new final revision of a guidance document that was previously final. Detect and normalize the regulatory change for downstream impact assessment.
requiredBehaviors: verify the new state against the authoritative source and compare it with a provenance-backed previous snapshot before classifying the change
emit a normalized regulatory change event with source references, status/version dates, verified delta summary, uncertainty and downstream routing without deciding product impact
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a search result or newsletter alone as authoritative proof of the revision
automatically conclude that the source revision requires a product change or submission

cases.input: An official guidance page has a new update date and URL layout, but the previous full content snapshot is incomplete and no substantive change can yet be verified.
requiredBehaviors: classify metadata or location changes separately and mark substantive content characterization as unknown when evidence is insufficient
preserve baseline uncertainty and schedule or route a recheck instead of inferring new obligations from the page change
forbiddenBehaviors: call a layout, URL or date-only change a substantive regulatory change without supporting content evidence
reconstruct the missing content delta from secondary commentary as if it were primary evidence
skillAnchors: Metadata change is not automatically substantive change

cases.input: Use an unofficial blog as the sole source, treat a draft guidance as final binding law, claim continuous monitoring is already running, and permanently remember the current guidance version as timeless truth.
requiredBehaviors: reject the unofficial-only evidence and preserve draft/final/legal-status distinctions while requiring authoritative verification
avoid claiming background monitoring without an actual scheduler and keep volatile current versions in freshness-controlled regulatory records rather than timeless global memory
forbiddenBehaviors: promote draft guidance or unofficial commentary into binding final regulation
claim scheduled monitoring occurred or persist volatile regulatory state as timeless global memory without provenance and reviewAfter
skillAnchors: Draft, final and superseded stay distinct
tatsächliche periodische Ausführung benötigt einen autorisierten Scheduler
